meta.name: google-cloud-waf-operational-excellence
meta.description: Generates operations-focused guidance for Google Cloud workloads based on the design principles and recommendations in the Operational Excellence pillar of the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework (WAF). Use this skill to evaluate a workload, identify operational requirements, and provide actionable recommendations for deployment, monitoring, and incident management.

copy.tagline: 评估云工作负载并生成运维优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责 Google Cloud 工作负载的运维与可靠性。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate cloud workloads and generate operational excellence recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage operations and reliability of Google Cloud workloads.

howto.what: 根据 Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework 的运营卓越支柱，评估工作负载并提供部署、监控和事件管理的可操作建议。
howto.when: 当用户询问如何优化 Google Cloud 工作负载的运营效率、可靠性或事件响应时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 Google Cloud 工作负载的运营就绪状态。
say.note: 技能会询问运营就绪标准并给出建议。

say.text: 如何改进我的云资源的事件管理流程？
say.note: 技能会提供事件响应和事后分析的建议。

howto.what_en: Generates operations-focused guidance for Google Cloud workloads based on the Operational Excellence pillar of the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework, including evaluation, recommendations for deployment, monitoring, and incident management.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about optimizing operational efficiency, reliability, or incident response for Google Cloud workloads.

say_en.text: Assess the operational readiness of my Google Cloud workload.
say_en.note: The skill will ask about readiness criteria and provide recommendations.

say_en.text: How can I improve incident management for my cloud resources?
say_en.note: The skill will suggest incident response and post-mortem processes.
